summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Sony Group Corporation reporting the grant of restricted stock units (RSUs) to directors, officers, and employees under an existing stock compensation plan. The filing discloses two series of RSUs: a Twentieth Series for directors (up to 44,400 shares vesting after nine years) and a Twenty-First Series for officers and employees (up to 1,244,188 shares vesting after three years). Vesting requires continuous service, with accelerated vesting upon death or approved departure. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation event. The filing is a routine equity compensation disclosure for a foreign private issuer.
